capabilities.name: Catalog & Metadata Management
capabilities.description: Curates e-book catalog metadata (ISBN, title, author, format, licensed copy count) and catalog structure.

capabilities.name: Circulation Management
capabilities.description: Governs borrowing, returns, loan periods, and hold/waitlist rules when no licensed copies are available.

obligationDefinitions.title: Concurrent loans must never exceed the licensed copy count
obligationDefinitions.description: Digital lending must enforce that the number of concurrent active loans for a title never exceeds its licensed copy count; a hold/waitlist queue must gate additional loans once the limit is reached, not silently over-lend.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: No title's concurrent active loan count exceeds its licensed copy count at any point.

requiredEvidence.title: Concurrent loan count check
requiredEvidence.description: Comparison of active loan counts against licensed copy counts per title.
